items.title: Why Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Stock Is Trading Up Today
items.summary: Shares of enterprise technology company Hewlett Packard Enterprise (NYSE:HPE) jumped 3.9% in the morning session after Morgan Stanley upgraded the stock to Overweight from Equal Weight and set a $69 price target. The firm said it had been “on the wrong side” of the enterprise hardware trade and now sees a stronger setup for HPE’s server business. Morgan Stanley’s shift rests on pricing and order strength.
